name: Standard 30-day returns
summary: Physical books may be returned within 30 days of delivery, in resalable condition.

name: Digital purchases are final
summary: Ebooks cannot be returned once the download has been made available.

name: Holiday sale extended returns
summary: Physical books bought during a Bookly holiday sale may be returned within 60 days of delivery instead of 30.

name: Bookly Australia extended returns
summary: A Bookly goodwill extension: customers in Australia get 45 days on physical books instead of 30. This is Bookly's own policy, not a statement about Australian law.
